Recently I tagged Planned Parenthood in a post and called them what Scripture calls them: a child sacrifice network.

Not “reproductive healthcare.” Not “women’s choice.”
Child sacrifice.

Because that’s what Leviticus 18:21 and Psalm 106:37-38 call the practice of offering children to foreign gods.

Today, I can’t access their profile. I’m not blocked. I’ve been shadow quarantined. Their page infinitely loads. Their account is untouchable, invisible to my digital existence. Every other profile works perfectly.

Welcome to Algorithmic Apologetics.

The Moloch Protection Racket

Here’s what happened: Major institutional accounts get special privileges. When you use biblical terminology for biblical sins, you trigger automated defense systems designed to shield modern Molech temples from prophetic exposure.

This isn’t a coincidence. This is programming.

The same platforms that let you call politicians every name in the book suddenly develop “technical difficulties” when you apply Scripture’s vocabulary to Scripture’s subjects.

Funny how that works.

“And they built the high places of Baal... to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into My mind, that they should do this abomination...” - Jeremiah 32:35

The Tell: When Digital Hits Different

Shadow-blocking isn’t censorship—it’s quarantine without notification. You’re not banned; you’re separated. Made invisible. Digital leprosy for calling unclean things unclean.

But here’s the tactical read: If my words were powerless, they’d ignore you.

The fact that calling abortion “child sacrifice” triggers institutional defenses tells you everything. Your framing has teeth. Your words carry weight they can’t afford to let circulate.

Truth doesn’t need protection algorithms. Lies do.

The Ancient Pattern in Digital Drag

This is the same spirit that drove Ahab and Jezebel to silence Elijah. Different century, same playbook:

  1. Build the high places.
  2. Normalize the practice.
  3. Silence anyone who uses the old vocabulary.

“Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, so Obadiah... hid them... in a cave, and fed them.” - 1 Kings 18:4

Sound familiar? The platform becomes the cave. The algorithm becomes the jailer.

When the System Shows Its Hand

Every shadow block is a confession. Every algorithmic quarantine is an admission that the words threaten their narrative. They’re not protecting us from “misinformation,” they’re protecting their altars from Scripture.

It’s documentation. Screenshots become evidence. Restricted accounts become proof of institutional capture.

“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not...” - 2 Corinthians 4:3-4

The Remnant Response

Document everything. Screenshot the restrictions. Archive the evidence. When calling child sacrifice “child sacrifice” gets you quarantined, you know whose altar the platform serves.

This isn’t persecution, it’s confirmation. The enemy only deploys countermeasures against threats.

Keep using biblical vocabulary for biblical realities. Let them build their digital high places. Let them program their algorithmic apologetics.

The Word still cuts. Even through fiber optic cables.

P.S. To the Christian content creators building your platforms on comfort and compromise: you have a choice. Wake up and confront this evil now, or be exposed by the light when He moves. Your silence isn’t wisdom; it’s cowardice. Your seeker-friendly theology is a betrayal of the prophets you claim to follow. The same fire that falls on the altars of Baal will test every work. Build on the Rock, not on the shifting sand of algorithmic approval.

“The word of God is not bound.” - 2 Timothy 2:9

Update:

The Three-Stage Psyop

STAGE ONE: Shadow Suppress

Make the target disappear without admitting it. Create "technical difficulties" that only affect certain voices. Let them wonder if they did something wrong or if their content just isn't engaging anymore. Gaslight them into questioning their own effectiveness.

STAGE TWO: Monitor and Test

Watch to see if they notice the suppression. Do they report it? Do they call it out publicly? How much evidence do they gather? This intelligence gathering phase determines the next tactical move.

STAGE THREE: Full Suppression

When stealth tactics get exposed, drop the pretense. Go full block, full ban, full deplatform. Claim "community violations" or "harmful content" to justify the censorship. Make them the villain for accurately describing your operations.

The Psychological Warfare Component:

Each stage is designed to create doubt, isolation, and self-censorship. The goal isn't just to silence you—it's to make you silence yourself by questioning whether your message is worth the social cost.

Those clowns think we can't see through their psychological warfare.
